title: Triage TermAl's open backlog (about 1240 items): classify each KEEP-NOW, KEEP, CLOSE-DONE, CLOSE-DUP, CLOSE-OBSOLETE or HELD with evidence, then apply spot-checked closures
outcome: Every open TermAl item is classified with a one-line reason and evidence. CLOSE-DONE cites the landed commit or the superseding item; CLOSE-DUP cites the surviving item; CLOSE-OBSOLETE cites the removed code, path or decision. Closures are applied by the coordinator after a spot check, each with its reason, never in bulk without evidence. KEEP-NOW items are aligned to Greg's pilot readiness bar (w-affe8a4dee48). The open count falls to what is really live, and the result is reported to Greg.
acceptance: Triage TermAl's open backlog (about 1240 items): classify each KEEP-NOW, KEEP, CLOSE-DONE, CLOSE-DUP, CLOSE-OBSOLETE or HELD with evidence, then apply spot-checked closures is done
